hero.subtitle: Empowering Ethiopians with affordable and accessible healthcare. A community solidarity program ensuring secure, digital medical coverage for every household.

health_rights.description: CBHI Ethiopia was founded on the belief that quality healthcare should never depend on financial status. Through community solidarity, we pool resources so every family, regardless of income, can access essential medical services.

equitable.title: Equitable Access
equitable.description: Ensuring every citizen, regardless of income, can access quality medical care when they need it most.

solidarity.title: Solidarity
solidarity.description: Communities coming together to protect each other from the financial shocks of illness.

coverage.description: From primary health centers to specialized surgery, CBHI covers what matters most.

primary.title: Primary Care
primary.description: Free consultations, check-ups, and basic treatments at any partner clinic.

hospitalization.title: Hospitalization
hospitalization.description: Full inpatient coverage including surgery, ICU, and essential post-care services.

maternal.title: Maternal & Child
maternal.description: Pre-natal, delivery, pediatric and postnatal care fully covered for every family.

enrollment.subtitle: Joining CBHI is simple. Follow these three steps at your local Woreda office and get covered the same day.

step1.title: Identity Check
step1.description: Register at your local Woreda with your Fayda ID. Our system integrates instantly for verification.
step1.badge: Bring your Fayda ID or national ID

step2.title: Annual Contribution
step2.description: Pay a small annual fee based on your household size. Flexible payment options available.

step3.title: Get Coverage
step3.description: Access healthcare instantly at any partner facility with your digital or physical CBHI card.

impact.subtitle: Measurable outcomes driving universal healthcare transformation across the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia.
